ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Ancient, TargetType.Self)` (BrightestFlame.cs:22-25) == cost 0 / SKILL / ANCIENT / SELF. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new MaxHpVar(1m)` + `new EnergyVar(2)` + `new CardsVar(2)` (BrightestFlame.cs:13-18) == all three numbers, all declared. `_energy` precedes `_cards` in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` so `magic_number` reports the energy, the card's headline number.

OnPlay.rationale: All three steps and their order match: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(Energy.IntValue, Owner)` -> `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` -> `CreatureCmd.LoseMaxHp(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, MaxHp.BaseValue, isFromCard: true)` (BrightestFlame.cs:29-31) == `EnergyCmd.gain` -> `DrawCmd.draw` -> `CreatureCmd.lose_max_hp`. The order matters (the draw precedes the max-HP loss, so the loss cannot cancel the draw) and is preserved. The card's OWN logic is faithful; see the guard for the verb it calls.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Energy.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` + `DynamicVars.Cards.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (BrightestFlame.cs:36-37) == `_energy += 1` (2 -> 3) and `_cards += 1` (2 -> 3). The MaxHp loss stays 1 when upgraded on both sides -- both upgraded numbers checked.

guards.what: CROSS-RECORD DISAGREEMENT (rule 3): CreatureCmd.LoseMaxHp(..., isFromCard: true) is seam gap G6, which labels itself DORMANT; this card makes it LIVE
guards.issue: The seam's VERDICT (`gap`) is not disputed and is not re-verdicted here -- only its liveness label is. creature_card_cmds guard G6 reasons: "Dormant: the two in-combat callers are Brightest Flame (cards/brightest_flame.py:37) and PaperCutsPower (powers.py:2959), neither of which reaches a fatal magnitude, and the isFromCard Move flag exists for cards that are not ported." That covers the KILL consequence and the Move flag but misses a third: C# `LoseMaxHp` routes the overflow through `Damage(..., Unblockable | Unpowered | Move, null, null)` (CreatureCmd.cs:826), which fires `Hook.AfterDamageReceived`; the sim's `lose_max_hp` (cmds.py:179-189) only clamps HP and calls `on_hp_changed`. `RupturePower.AfterDamageReceived` gains Strength on ANY unblocked damage its owner receives, and its `cardSource == null` branch (RupturePower.cs:48-51) is exactly the branch LoseMaxHp's null cardSource takes. Rupture IS ported (sts2_rl/cards/rupture_card.py; power at powers.py:272-289, listening on `on_damage_received`). Play Brightest Flame at full HP holding Rupture: newMaxHp < CurrentHp, so the game deals 1 damage and Rupture triggers; the sim gains no Strength. Both halves are ported Ironclad content, so this is LIVE. Reported for the seam owner; this record does not edit audit/records/seam/**.
